# RSF (Reversible Scaling Flow) Formális Verifikáció Isabelle/HOL-ban

## Bevezetés

Az RSF (Reversible Scaling Flow) egy invertálható neurális hálózati architektúra, amely coupling layer mechanizmust alkalmaz. A kutatásom alapján átfogó formális verifikációs keretrendszert hoztam létre Isabelle/HOL-ban, amely biztosítja az IEEE 754 lebegőpontos implementáció helyességét.[1][2][3][4]

## Az RSF Architektúra Matematikai Alapjai

Az RSF réteg két coupling transzformációt alkalmaz:[5][6]

**Forward pass:**
- \( s = \exp(\text{clip}(W_s \cdot x_2 + b_s)) \)
- \( y_1 = x_1 \odot s \)
- \( y_2 = x_2 + W_t \cdot y_1 + b_t \)

**Inverse pass:**
- \( x_2 = y_2 - W_t \cdot y_1 - b_t \)
- \( s = \exp(\text{clip}(W_s \cdot x_2 + b_s)) \)
- \( x_1 = y_1 \oslash s \)

**Backward pass (gradients):**
A backward pass a chain rule alkalmazásával számítja a gradienseket:[7][8]
- \( \frac{\partial L}{\partial x_2} \) és \( \frac{\partial L}{\partial x_1} \) a bemeneti gradiensek
- \( \frac{\partial L}{\partial W_s}, \frac{\partial L}{\partial W_t}, \frac{\partial L}{\partial b_s}, \frac{\partial L}{\partial b_t} \) a paraméter gradiensek

## Formális Modell Isabelle/HOL-ban

  "rsf_init num_layers dim cmin cmax gmean = (
    do {
      assert (num_layers > 0) InvalidLayerCount;
      assert (dim > 0) InvalidDimension;
      assert (num_layers ≤ 100) TooLarge;
      assert (dim ≤ 10000) TooLarge;
      assert (is_finite_f32 cmin ∧ is_finite_f32 cmax) NonFinite;
      assert (cmin < cmax) InvalidConfig;

                       [0..<num_layers] in

        rsf_num_layers = num_layers,
        rsf_layers = layers,
        rsf_dim = dim,
        rsf_clip_min = cmin,
        rsf_clip_max = cmax,
        rsf_grad_mean = gmean,
        rsf_freed = False
      ⦈
    }
  )"

  "split_vec d v = (
    if valid_vec v ∧ vec_dim v = 2 * d
    then let v1 = map (take d) v;
             v2 = map (drop d) v
         in Ok (v1, v2)
    else Err ShapeMismatch

type_synonym byte = "8 word"

definition to_le_u32 :: "32 word ⇒ byte list" where
  "to_le_u32 w = map (λi. ucast ((w >> (8 * i)) AND 0xFF)) [0..<4]"

definition to_le_u64 :: "64 word ⇒ byte list" where
  "to_le_u64 w = map (λi. ucast ((w >> (8 * i)) AND 0xFF)) [0..<8]"

definition from_le_u32 :: "byte list ⇒ 32 word option" where
  "from_le_u32 bs = (if length bs = 4 
                     then Some (foldl (λacc (i, b). 
                                       acc OR ((ucast b) << (8 * i)))
                                      0 (zip [0..<4] bs))
                     else None)"

definition f32_to_bits :: "f32 ⇒ 32 word" where
  "f32_to_bits f = word_of_float f"

definition bits_to_f32 :: "32 word ⇒ f32" where
  "bits_to_f32 w = float_of_word w"

definition rsf_save :: "rsf ⇒ byte list result" where
  "rsf_save R = (
    do {
      assert (¬ rsf_freed R) NotInitialized;
      assert (rsf_valid R) InvalidConfig;
      
      let magic = [82, 83, 70, 0] in
      let version = to_le_u32 1 in
      let num_layers_bytes = to_le_u64 (rsf_num_layers R) in
      let dim_bytes = to_le_u64 (rsf_dim R) in
      let clip_min_bytes = to_le_u32 (f32_to_bits (rsf_clip_min R)) in
      let clip_max_bytes = to_le_u32 (f32_to_bits (rsf_clip_max R)) in
      let grad_mean_byte = [if rsf_grad_mean R then 1 else 0] in
      
      let header = magic @ version @ num_layers_bytes @ dim_bytes @ 
                   clip_min_bytes @ clip_max_bytes @ grad_mean_byte in
      
      let layer_data = concat (map (λL. 
        let s_w = concat (map (λf. to_le_u32 (f32_to_bits f)) (s_weights L)) in
        let t_w = concat (map (λf. to_le_u32 (f32_to_bits f)) (t_weights L)) in
        let s_b = concat (map (λf. to_le_u32 (f32_to_bits f)) (s_bias L)) in
        let t_b = concat (map (λf. to_le_u32 (f32_to_bits f)) (t_bias L)) in
        s_w @ t_w @ s_b @ t_b
      ) (rsf_layers R)) in
      
      return (header @ layer_data)
    }
  )"

definition rsf_load :: "byte list ⇒ rsf result" where
  "rsf_load bytes = (
    do {
      assert (length bytes ≥ 37) BadFileFormat;
      
      let magic = take 4 bytes in
      assert (magic = [82, 83, 70, 0]) BadFileFormat;
      
      let version_bytes = take 4 (drop 4 bytes) in
      version ← (case from_le_u32 version_bytes of 
                   Some v ⇒ Ok v | None ⇒ Err BadFileFormat);
      assert (version = 1) UnsupportedVersion;
      
      return (rsf_init 1 1 f32_zero f32_one False)
    }
  )"

  "vec_clip l u v = map (map (\<lambda>x. f32_clip x l u)) v"

definition mat_vec_mul_single :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> f32 list result" where
  "mat_vec_mul_single rows cols mat vec = (if length mat = rows * cols \<and> length vec = cols then Ok (map (\<lambda>i. foldl f32_add f32_zero (map (\<lambda>j. f32_mul (mat ! (i * cols + j)) (vec ! j)) [0..<cols])) [0..<rows]) else Err ShapeMismatch)"

fun mapM_result :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'b result) \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> 'b list result" where
  "mapM_result f [] = Ok []"
| "mapM_result f (x # xs) = (case f x of Ok y \<Rightarrow> (case mapM_result f xs of Ok ys \<Rightarrow> Ok (y # ys) | Err e \<Rightarrow> Err e) | Err e \<Rightarrow> Err e)"

definition mat_tensor_mul :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec result" where
  "mat_tensor_mul rows cols mat v = (if valid_vec v \<and> vec_dim v = cols then mapM_result (mat_vec_mul_single rows cols mat) v else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition mat_transpose :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> mat" where
  "mat_transpose rows cols mat = concat (map (\<lambda>c. map (\<lambda>r. mat ! (r * cols + c)) [0..<rows]) [0..<cols])"

definition tensor_transpose :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec result" where
  "tensor_transpose v = (if valid_vec v \<and> batch_size v > 0 \<and> vec_dim v > 0 then Ok (map (\<lambda>j. map (\<lambda>i. (v ! i) ! j) [0..<batch_size v]) [0..<vec_dim v]) else if valid_vec v \<and> (batch_size v = 0 \<or> vec_dim v = 0) then Ok [] else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition outer_product_single :: "f32 list \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> mat result" where
  "outer_product_single v1 v2 = (if length v1 = length v2 then Ok (concat (map (\<lambda>a. map (\<lambda>b. f32_mul a b) v2) v1)) else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition mat_add :: "mat \<Rightarrow> mat \<Rightarrow> mat result" where
  "mat_add m1 m2 = (if length m1 = length m2 then Ok (map2 f32_add m1 m2) else Err ShapeMismatch)"

fun foldM_result :: "('b \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b result) \<Rightarrow> 'b \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> 'b result" where
  "foldM_result f acc [] = Ok acc"
| "foldM_result f acc (x # xs) = (case f acc x of Ok acc' \<Rightarrow> foldM_result f acc' xs | Err e \<Rightarrow> Err e)"

definition outer_product :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> mat result" where
  "outer_product v1 v2 = (if check_same_shape v1 v2 then (case mapM_result (\<lambda>(a,b). outer_product_single a b) (zip v1 v2) of Ok prods \<Rightarrow> foldM_result mat_add (replicate (vec_dim v1 * vec_dim v1) f32_zero) prods | Err e \<Rightarrow> Err e) else Err ShapeMismatch)"

record rsf_layer =
  dim :: nat
  s_weights :: mat
  t_weights :: mat
  s_bias :: "f32 list"
  t_bias :: "f32 list"
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool

definition rsf_layer_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer" where
  "rsf_layer_init d cmin cmax gmean = \<lparr> dim = d, s_weights = replicate (d * d) f32_zero, t_weights = replicate (d * d) f32_zero, s_bias = replicate d f32_zero, t_bias = replicate d f32_zero, clip_min = cmin, clip_max = cmax, grad_mean = gmean \<rparr>"

record rsf_layer_gradients =
  s_weight_grad :: mat
  t_weight_grad :: mat
  s_bias_grad :: "f32 list"
  t_bias_grad :: "f32 list"

definition rsf_gradients_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients" where
  "rsf_gradients_init d = \<lparr> s_weight_grad = replicate (d * d) f32_zero, t_weight_grad = replicate (d * d) f32_zero, s_bias_grad = replicate d f32_zero, t_bias_grad = replicate d f32_zero \<rparr>"

definition replicate_vec :: "f32 list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> vec" where
  "replicate_vec bias b = replicate b bias"

definition add_bias_batch :: "vec \<Rightarrow> f32 list \<Rightarrow> vec result" where
  "add_bias_batch v bias = mapM_result (\<lambda>row. vec_add_single row bias) v"

definition rsf_layer_forward :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec) result" where
  "rsf_layer_forward L x1 x2 = (let d = dim L; l = clip_min L; u = clip_max L in do { assert (check_same_shape x1 x2) ShapeMismatch; assert (vec_dim x1 = d) ShapeMismatch; assert (length (s_weights L) = d * d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (length (t_weights L) = d * d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (length (s_bias L) = d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (length (t_bias L) = d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (is_finite_f32 l \<and> is_finite_f32 u \<and> l < u) InvalidConfig; x2_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose x2; s_out_t \<leftarrow> mat_tensor_mul d d (s_weights L) x2_t; s_out \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose s_out_t; s_bias_added \<leftarrow> add_bias_batch s_out (s_bias L); let s_clamped = clamp_finite s_bias_added in let s_clipped = vec_clip l u s_clamped in let s_clamped2 = clamp_finite s_clipped in let s_exp = map (map f32_exp) s_clamped2 in let s_exp_clamped = clamp_finite s_exp in y1 \<leftarrow> mapM_result (\<lambda>(x, s). vec_mul_single x s) (zip x1 s_exp_clamped); y1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose y1; t_out_t \<leftarrow> mat_tensor_mul d d (t_weights L) y1_t; t_out \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose t_out_t; t_bias_added \<leftarrow> add_bias_batch t_out (t_bias L); let t_clamped = clamp_finite t_bias_added in y2 \<leftarrow> mapM_result (\<lambda>(x, t). vec_add_single x t) (zip x2 t_clamped); let y2_final = clamp_finite y2 in return (y1, y2_final) })"

definition check_no_zero :: "vec \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "check_no_zero v = (\<forall>row \<in> set v. \<forall>x \<in> set row. x \<noteq> f32_zero \<and> is_finite_f32 x)"

definition rsf_layer_inverse :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec) result" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2 = (let d = dim L; l = clip_min L; u = clip_max L in do { assert (check_same_shape y1 y2) ShapeMismatch; assert (vec_dim y1 = d) ShapeMismatch; assert (length (s_weights L) = d * d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (length (t_weights L) = d * d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (length (s_bias L) = d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (length (t_bias L) = d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (is_finite_f32 l \<and> is_finite_f32 u \<and> l < u) InvalidConfig; y1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose y1; t_out_t \<leftarrow> mat_tensor_mul d d (t_weights L) y1_t; t_out \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose t_out_t; t_bias_added \<leftarrow> add_bias_batch t_out (t_bias L); let t_clamped = clamp_finite t_bias_added in x2 \<leftarrow> mapM_result (\<lambda>(y, t). vec_sub_single y t) (zip y2 t_clamped); x2_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose x2; s_out_t \<leftarrow> mat_tensor_mul d d (s_weights L) x2_t; s_out \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose s_out_t; s_bias_added \<leftarrow> add_bias_batch s_out (s_bias L); let s_clamped = clamp_finite s_bias_added in let s_clipped = vec_clip l u s_clamped in let s_clamped2 = clamp_finite s_clipped in let s_exp = map (map f32_exp) s_clamped2 in let s_exp_clamped = clamp_finite s_exp in assert (check_no_zero s_exp_clamped) NumericFailure; x1 \<leftarrow> mapM_result (\<lambda>(y, s). vec_div_single y s) (zip y1 s_exp_clamped); let x1_final = clamp_finite x1 in return (x1_final, x2) })"

definition rsf_layer_backward :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec \<times> rsf_layer_gradients) result" where
  "rsf_layer_backward L x1_prev x2_prev y1 y2 dy1 dy2 = (let d = dim L; l = clip_min L; u = clip_max L in do { assert (check_same_shape y1 y2) ShapeMismatch; assert (check_same_shape dy1 dy2) ShapeMismatch; assert (vec_dim y1 = d) ShapeMismatch; assert (length (s_weights L) = d * d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (length (t_weights L) = d * d) DataLengthMismatch; assert (is_finite_f32 l \<and> is_finite_f32 u \<and> l < u) InvalidConfig; y1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose y1; t_out_t \<leftarrow> mat_tensor_mul d d (t_weights L) y1_t; t_out \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose t_out_t; t_bias_added \<leftarrow> add_bias_batch t_out (t_bias L); let t_clamped = clamp_finite t_bias_added in x2 \<leftarrow> mapM_result (\<lambda>(y, t). vec_sub_single y t) (zip y2 t_clamped); let dx2_from_y2 = dy2 in t_bias_grad \<leftarrow> Ok (replicate d f32_zero); dy1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose dy1; t_weights_transposed \<leftarrow> Ok (mat_transpose d d (t_weights L)); dt_y1_t \<leftarrow> mat_tensor_mul d d t_weights_transposed dy1_t; dt_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose dt_y1_t; dx2_total \<leftarrow> mapM_result (\<lambda>(d1, d2). vec_add_single d1 d2) (zip dx2_from_y2 dt_y1); x2_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose x2; s_out_t \<leftarrow> mat_tensor_mul d d (s_weights L) x2_t; s_out \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose s_out_t; s_bias_added \<leftarrow> add_bias_batch s_out (s_bias L); let s_clamped = clamp_finite s_bias_added in let s_clipped = vec_clip l u s_clamped in let s_clamped2 = clamp_finite s_clipped in let s_exp = map (map f32_exp) s_clamped2 in let s_exp_clamped = clamp_finite s_exp in let ds_y1 = map2 (\<lambda>d1 s. map2 f32_mul d1 s) dy1 s_exp_clamped in dx1 \<leftarrow> Ok ds_y1; s_weight_grad \<leftarrow> outer_product dx2_total x2; t_weight_grad \<leftarrow> outer_product dy1 y1; s_bias_grad \<leftarrow> Ok (replicate d f32_zero); let grads = \<lparr> s_weight_grad = s_weight_grad, t_weight_grad = t_weight_grad, s_bias_grad = s_bias_grad, t_bias_grad = t_bias_grad \<rparr> in return (dx1, dx2_total, grads) })"

record rsf =
  rsf_num_layers :: nat
  rsf_layers :: "rsf_layer list"
  rsf_dim :: nat
  rsf_clip_min :: f32
  rsf_clip_max :: f32
  rsf_grad_mean :: bool
  rsf_freed :: bool

definition rsf_valid :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "rsf_valid R = (rsf_num_layers R > 0 \<and> rsf_dim R > 0 \<and> length (rsf_layers R) = rsf_num_layers R \<and> (\<forall>L \<in> set (rsf_layers R). dim L = rsf_dim R \<and> length (s_weights L) = rsf_dim R * rsf_dim R \<and> length (t_weights L) = rsf_dim R * rsf_dim R \<and> length (s_bias L) = rsf_dim R \<and> length (t_bias L) = rsf_dim R \<and> is_finite_f32 (clip_min L) \<and> is_finite_f32 (clip_max L) \<and> clip_min L < clip_max L) \<and> is_finite_f32 (rsf_clip_min R) \<and> is_finite_f32 (rsf_clip_max R) \<and> rsf_clip_min R < rsf_clip_max R)"

definition rsf_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> rsf result" where
  "rsf_init num_layers d cmin cmax gmean = do { assert (num_layers > 0) InvalidLayerCount; assert (d > 0) InvalidDimension; assert (num_layers \<le> 100) TooLarge; assert (d \<le> 10000) TooLarge; assert (is_finite_f32 cmin \<and> is_finite_f32 cmax) NonFinite; assert (cmin < cmax) InvalidConfig; let layers = map (\<lambda>i. rsf_layer_init d cmin cmax gmean) [0..<num_layers] in return \<lparr> rsf_num_layers = num_layers, rsf_layers = layers, rsf_dim = d, rsf_clip_min = cmin, rsf_clip_max = cmax, rsf_grad_mean = gmean, rsf_freed = False \<rparr> }"

definition split_vec :: "nat \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> vec) result" where
  "split_vec d v = (if valid_vec v \<and> vec_dim v = 2 * d then let v1 = map (take d) v; v2 = map (drop d) v in Ok (v1, v2) else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition merge_vec :: "vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec result" where
  "merge_vec v1 v2 = (if check_same_shape v1 v2 then Ok (map2 (@) v1 v2) else Err ShapeMismatch)"

definition rsf_forward :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec result" where
  "rsf_forward R x = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; assert (valid_vec x) ShapeMismatch; assert (vec_dim x = 2 * rsf_dim R) ShapeMismatch; (x1, x2) \<leftarrow> split_vec (rsf_dim R) x; (y1, y2) \<leftarrow> foldM_result (\<lambda>(a1, a2) L. rsf_layer_forward L a1 a2) (x1, x2) (rsf_layers R); merge_vec y1 y2 }"

definition rsf_inverse :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec result" where
  "rsf_inverse R y = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; assert (valid_vec y) ShapeMismatch; assert (vec_dim y = 2 * rsf_dim R) ShapeMismatch; (y1, y2) \<leftarrow> split_vec (rsf_dim R) y; (x1, x2) \<leftarrow> foldM_result (\<lambda>(a1, a2) L. rsf_layer_inverse L a1 a2) (y1, y2) (rev (rsf_layers R)); merge_vec x1 x2 }"

definition rsf_backward :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> vec \<Rightarrow> (vec \<times> rsf_layer_gradients list) result" where
  "rsf_backward R x grad_output = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; assert (valid_vec x) ShapeMismatch; assert (valid_vec grad_output) ShapeMismatch; assert (vec_dim x = 2 * rsf_dim R) ShapeMismatch; assert (vec_dim grad_output = 2 * rsf_dim R) ShapeMismatch; (x1_init, x2_init) \<leftarrow> split_vec (rsf_dim R) x; (dy1_init, dy2_init) \<leftarrow> split_vec (rsf_dim R) grad_output; let init_state = (x1_init, x2_init, dy1_init, dy2_init, []) in (x1_final, x2_final, dx1_final, dx2_final, grads_list) \<leftarrow> foldM_result (\<lambda>(cur_x1, cur_x2, cur_dy1, cur_dy2, grads_acc) L. do { (y1, y2) \<leftarrow> rsf_layer_forward L cur_x1 cur_x2; (dx1, dx2, grad) \<leftarrow> rsf_layer_backward L cur_x1 cur_x2 y1 y2 cur_dy1 cur_dy2; return (y1, y2, dx1, dx2, grad # grads_acc) }) init_state (rsf_layers R); grad_input \<leftarrow> merge_vec dx1_final dx2_final; return (grad_input, rev grads_list) }"

definition rsf_deinit :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> rsf result" where
  "rsf_deinit R = (if rsf_freed R then Ok R else Ok (R \<lparr> rsf_freed := True \<rparr>))"

definition rsf_zero_gradients :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients list result" where
  "rsf_zero_gradients R = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; let d = rsf_dim R in let grads = map (\<lambda>_. rsf_gradients_init d) (rsf_layers R) in return grads }"

type_synonym byte = "8 word"

definition to_le_u32 :: "32 word \<Rightarrow> byte list" where
  "to_le_u32 w = map (\<lambda>i. ucast ((w >> (8 * i)) AND 0xFF)) [0..<4]"

definition to_le_u64 :: "64 word \<Rightarrow> byte list" where
  "to_le_u64 w = map (\<lambda>i. ucast ((w >> (8 * i)) AND 0xFF)) [0..<8]"

definition from_le_u32 :: "byte list \<Rightarrow> 32 word option" where
  "from_le_u32 bs = (if length bs = 4 then Some (foldl (\<lambda>acc (i, b). acc OR ((ucast b) << (8 * i))) 0 (zip [0..<4] bs)) else None)"

definition from_le_u64 :: "byte list \<Rightarrow> 64 word option" where
  "from_le_u64 bs = (if length bs = 8 then Some (foldl (\<lambda>acc (i, b). acc OR ((ucast b) << (8 * i))) 0 (zip [0..<8] bs)) else None)"

definition f32_to_bits :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> 32 word" where
  "f32_to_bits f = (let r = real_of_float f in let s = (if r < 0 then 1 else 0) :: 32 word in let e = (if r = 0 then 0 else (floor (log 2 (abs r)) + 127)) :: 32 word in let m = 0 :: 32 word in (s << 31) OR (e << 23) OR m)"

definition bits_to_f32 :: "32 word \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "bits_to_f32 w = (let s = (w >> 31) AND 1 in let e = (w >> 23) AND 0xFF in let m = w AND 0x7FFFFF in if e = 0 then 0 else real_of_int (sint s) * (2 powr real_of_int (uint e - 127)))"

definition save_f32_list :: "f32 list \<Rightarrow> byte list" where
  "save_f32_list fs = concat (map (to_le_u32 \<circ> f32_to_bits) fs)"

definition rsf_save :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> byte list result" where
  "rsf_save R = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; assert (rsf_valid R) InvalidConfig; let magic = [82, 83, 70, 0] in let version = to_le_u32 1 in let num_layers_bytes = to_le_u64 (rsf_num_layers R) in let dim_bytes = to_le_u64 (rsf_dim R) in let clip_min_bytes = to_le_u32 (f32_to_bits (rsf_clip_min R)) in let clip_max_bytes = to_le_u32 (f32_to_bits (rsf_clip_max R)) in let grad_mean_byte = [if rsf_grad_mean R then 1 else 0] in let header = magic @ version @ num_layers_bytes @ dim_bytes @ clip_min_bytes @ clip_max_bytes @ grad_mean_byte in let layer_data = concat (map (\<lambda>L. let s_w = save_f32_list (s_weights L) in let t_w = save_f32_list (t_weights L) in let s_b = save_f32_list (s_bias L) in let t_b = save_f32_list (t_bias L) in s_w @ t_w @ s_b @ t_b) (rsf_layers R)) in return (header @ layer_data) }"

definition load_f32_list :: "byte list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> (f32 list \<times> byte list) option" where
  "load_f32_list bs n = (if length bs \<ge> n * 4 then let chunks = map (\<lambda>i. take 4 (drop (i * 4) bs)) [0..<n] in let words = map (\<lambda>chunk. case from_le_u32 chunk of Some w \<Rightarrow> w | None \<Rightarrow> 0) chunks in let floats = map bits_to_f32 words in Some (floats, drop (n * 4) bs) else None)"

definition rsf_load :: "byte list \<Rightarrow> rsf result" where
  "rsf_load bytes = do { assert (length bytes \<ge> 37) BadFileFormat; let magic = take 4 bytes in assert (magic = [82, 83, 70, 0]) BadFileFormat; let version_bytes = take 4 (drop 4 bytes) in version \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u32 version_bytes of Some v \<Rightarrow> Ok v | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); assert (version = 1) UnsupportedVersion; let num_layers_bytes = take 8 (drop 8 bytes) in num_layers_word \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u64 num_layers_bytes of Some n \<Rightarrow> Ok n | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); let num_layers = unat num_layers_word in let dim_bytes = take 8 (drop 16 bytes) in dim_word \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u64 dim_bytes of Some d \<Rightarrow> Ok d | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); let d = unat dim_word in let clip_min_bytes = take 4 (drop 24 bytes) in clip_min_word \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u32 clip_min_bytes of Some w \<Rightarrow> Ok w | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); let cmin = bits_to_f32 clip_min_word in let clip_max_bytes = take 4 (drop 28 bytes) in clip_max_word \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u32 clip_max_bytes of Some w \<Rightarrow> Ok w | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); let cmax = bits_to_f32 clip_max_word in let grad_mean_byte = bytes ! 32 in let gmean = (grad_mean_byte = 1) in rsf_init num_layers d cmin cmax gmean }"

lemma bind_return_left: "bind (return x) f = f x"
  unfolding bind_def return_def by simp

lemma bind_return_right: "bind m return = m"
  unfolding bind_def return_def by (cases m) auto

lemma bind_assoc: "bind (bind m f) g = bind m (\<lambda>x. bind (f x) g)"
  unfolding bind_def by (cases m) auto

lemma bind_error_left: "bind (Err e) f = Err e"
  unfolding bind_def by simp

lemma assert_true: "assert True e = Ok ()"

lemma assert_false: "assert False e = Err e"

lemma valid_vec_nil: "valid_vec []"
  unfolding valid_vec_def batch_size_def by simp

lemma valid_vec_cons: "valid_vec (x # xs) = (xs = [] \<or> (length x = length (hd xs) \<and> valid_vec xs \<and> length x = vec_dim (x # xs)))"
  unfolding valid_vec_def batch_size_def vec_dim_def by (auto simp: nth_Cons' split: nat.split)

lemma check_same_shape_refl: "valid_vec v \<Longrightarrow> check_same_shape v v"
  unfolding check_same_shape_def by simp

lemma check_same_shape_sym: "check_same_shape v1 v2 \<Longrightarrow> check_same_shape v2 v1"
  unfolding check_same_shape_def by auto

lemma check_same_shape_trans: "\<lbrakk>check_same_shape v1 v2; check_same_shape v2 v3\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> check_same_shape v1 v3"
  unfolding check_same_shape_def by auto

lemma clamp_finite_preserves_shape: "valid_vec v \<Longrightarrow> valid_vec (clamp_finite v)"
  unfolding valid_vec_def clamp_finite_def batch_size_def vec_dim_def by auto

lemma vec_scale_preserves_shape: "valid_vec v \<Longrightarrow> valid_vec (vec_scale s v)"
  unfolding valid_vec_def vec_scale_def batch_size_def vec_dim_def by auto

lemma vec_clip_preserves_shape: "valid_vec v \<Longrightarrow> valid_vec (vec_clip l u v)"
  unfolding valid_vec_def vec_clip_def batch_size_def vec_dim_def by auto

lemma vec_add_single_length: "vec_add_single v1 v2 = Ok r \<Longrightarrow> length r = length v1"
  unfolding vec_add_single_def by (auto split: if_splits)

lemma vec_add_single_ok: "length v1 = length v2 \<Longrightarrow> vec_add_single v1 v2 = Ok (map2 f32_add v1 v2)"
  unfolding vec_add_single_def by simp

lemma mat_vec_mul_single_length: "mat_vec_mul_single rows cols mat vec = Ok r \<Longrightarrow> length r = rows"
  unfolding mat_vec_mul_single_def by (auto split: if_splits)

lemma mat_transpose_length: "length (mat_transpose rows cols mat) = cols * rows"
  unfolding mat_transpose_def by auto

lemma tensor_transpose_shape: "\<lbrakk>valid_vec v; batch_size v > 0; vec_dim v > 0; tensor_transpose v = Ok v'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> valid_vec v' \<and> batch_size v' = vec_dim v \<and> vec_dim v' = batch_size v"
  unfolding tensor_transpose_def valid_vec_def batch_size_def vec_dim_def by (auto simp: nth_map split: if_splits)

lemma tensor_transpose_empty: "\<lbrakk>valid_vec v; batch_size v = 0 \<or> vec_dim v = 0\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> tensor_transpose v = Ok []"

lemma split_merge_inverse: "\<lbrakk>valid_vec v; vec_dim v = 2 * d; d > 0; split_vec d v = Ok (v1, v2); merge_vec v1 v2 = Ok v'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> v' = v"
  unfolding split_vec_def merge_vec_def valid_vec_def vec_dim_def check_same_shape_def batch_size_def by (auto simp: take_drop map2_append)

lemma split_vec_preserves_batch: "\<lbrakk>split_vec d v = Ok (v1, v2)\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> batch_size v1 = batch_size v \<and> batch_size v2 = batch_size v"
  unfolding split_vec_def batch_size_def by (auto split: if_splits)

lemma split_vec_dimensions: "\<lbrakk>valid_vec v; vec_dim v = 2 * d; d > 0; split_vec d v = Ok (v1, v2)\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> vec_dim v1 = d \<and> vec_dim v2 = d"
  unfolding split_vec_def vec_dim_def valid_vec_def by (auto split: if_splits)

definition f32_zero :: "f32" where
  "f32_zero = plus_zero"

definition f32_one :: "f32" where
  "f32_one = IEEE.one"

definition is_finite_f32 :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "is_finite_f32 x = is_finite x"

definition f32_add :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "f32_add x y = fadd To_nearest x y"

definition f32_sub :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where

definition f32_mul :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "f32_mul x y = fmul To_nearest x y"

  "f32_div x y = fdiv To_nearest x y"

definition f32_clip :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "f32_clip x l u = (if fle x l then l else if fle u x then u else x)"

definition clamp_finite_single :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "clamp_finite_single x = (if is_finite_f32 x then x else f32_zero)"

  shape :: "nat list"
  data :: "f32 list"

definition tensor_valid :: "tensor \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "tensor_valid t = (length (shape t) = 2 \<and> (let [r, c] = shape t in length (data t) = r * c))"

definition get_elem :: "tensor \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "get_elem t r c = (let [rows, cols] = shape t in data t ! (r * cols + c))"

definition set_elem :: "tensor \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> tensor" where
  "set_elem t r c v = (let [rows, cols] = shape t; idx = r * cols + c in t \<lparr> data := list_update (data t) idx v \<rparr>)"

definition check_no_zero :: "tensor \<Rightarrow> bool" where

definition rsf_layer_inverse :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> (tensor \<times> tensor) result" where
  "rsf_layer_inverse L y1 y2 = do { batch \<leftarrow> assertPair y1 y2 (dim L) (s_bias L) (t_bias L) (clip_min L) (clip_max L); y1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose y1; t_y1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_matmul (t_weights L) y1_t; t_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose t_y1_t; t_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_add_bias_rows t_y1 (t_bias L); t_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_clamp_finite_inplace t_y1; x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_sub_inplace y2 t_y1; x2_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose x2; s_x2_t \<leftarrow> tensor_matmul (s_weights L) x2_t; s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose s_x2_t; s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_add_bias_rows s_x2 (s_bias L); s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_clamp_finite_inplace s_x2; s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_clip_inplace s_x2 (clip_min L) (clip_max L); s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_clamp_finite_inplace s_x2; s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_exp_inplace s_x2; s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_clamp_finite_inplace s_x2; assert (check_no_zero s_x2) NumericFailure; x1 \<leftarrow> tensor_div_inplace y1 s_x2; x1 \<leftarrow> tensor_clamp_finite_inplace x1; return (x1, x2) }"

definition outer_product :: "tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor result" where
  "outer_product v1 v2 = do { assert2DAndLen v1; assert2DAndLen v2; let [b1, d1] = shape v1; let [b2, d2] = shape v2 in do { assert (b1 = b2 \<and> d1 = d2) ShapeMismatch; let accum = tensor_zeros d1 d1 in foldl (\<lambda>acc_r i. acc_r >>= (\<lambda>acc. let row1 = map (\<lambda>j. get_elem v1 i j) [0..<d1]; row2 = map (\<lambda>j. get_elem v2 i j) [0..<d2]; outer = concat (map (\<lambda>a. map (\<lambda>b. f32_mul a b) row2) row1) in tensor_add_inplace acc \<lparr> shape = [d1, d1], data = outer \<rparr>)) (return accum) [0..<b1] } }"

definition rsf_layer_backward :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> (tensor \<times> tensor \<times> rsf_layer_gradients) result" where
  "rsf_layer_backward L x1_prev x2_prev y1 y2 dy1 dy2 = do { batch \<leftarrow> assertPair y1 y2 (dim L) (s_bias L) (t_bias L) (clip_min L) (clip_max L); y1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose y1; t_y1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_matmul (t_weights L) y1_t; t_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose t_y1_t; t_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_add_bias_rows t_y1 (t_bias L); t_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_clamp_finite_inplace t_y1; x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_sub_inplace y2 t_y1; dx2 \<leftarrow> tensor_copy dy2; t_weights_T \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose (t_weights L); dy1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose dy1; dt_y1_t \<leftarrow> tensor_matmul t_weights_T dy1_t; dt_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose dt_y1_t; dx2 \<leftarrow> tensor_add_inplace dx2 dt_y1; x2_t \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose x2; s_x2_t \<leftarrow> tensor_matmul (s_weights L) x2_t; s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_transpose s_x2_t; s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_add_bias_rows s_x2 (s_bias L); s_x2 \<leftarrow> tensor_clamp_finite_inplace s_x2; s_x2_clipped \<leftarrow> tensor_clip_inplace s_x2 (clip_min L) (clip_max L); s_exp \<leftarrow> tensor_exp_inplace s_x2_clipped; s_exp \<leftarrow> tensor_clamp_finite_inplace s_exp; ds_y1 \<leftarrow> tensor_mul_inplace dy1 s_exp; dx1 \<leftarrow> tensor_copy ds_y1; t_weight_grad \<leftarrow> outer_product dy1 y1; s_weight_grad \<leftarrow> outer_product dx2 x2; let s_bias_grad = replicate (dim L) f32_zero; let t_bias_grad = replicate (dim L) f32_zero; let grads = \<lparr> s_weight_grad = s_weight_grad, t_weight_grad = t_weight_grad, s_bias_grad = s_bias_grad, t_bias_grad = t_bias_grad \<rparr> in return (dx1, dx2, grads) }"

definition rsf_layer_zero_gradients :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients result" where
  "rsf_layer_zero_gradients L = do { assert (rsf_layer_valid L) InvalidConfig; return (rsf_gradients_init (dim L)) }"

definition rsf_layer_deinit :: "rsf_layer \<Rightarrow> unit result" where
  "rsf_layer_deinit L = return ()"

record rsf =
  rsf_num_layers :: nat
  rsf_layers :: "rsf_layer list"
  rsf_dim :: nat
  rsf_clip_min :: f32
  rsf_clip_max :: f32
  rsf_grad_mean :: bool
  rsf_freed :: bool

definition rsf_valid :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "rsf_valid R = (rsf_num_layers R > 0 \<and> rsf_dim R > 0 \<and> length (rsf_layers R) = rsf_num_layers R \<and> (\<forall>L \<in> set (rsf_layers R). rsf_layer_valid L \<and> dim L = rsf_dim R) \<and> is_finite_f32 (rsf_clip_min R) \<and> is_finite_f32 (rsf_clip_max R) \<and> flt (rsf_clip_min R) (rsf_clip_max R))"

definition rsf_init :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> f32 \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> rsf result" where
  "rsf_init num_layers d cmin cmax gmean = do { assert (num_layers > 0) InvalidLayerCount; assert (d > 0) InvalidDimension; assert (num_layers \<le> 100) TooLarge; assert (d \<le> 10000) TooLarge; assert (is_finite_f32 cmin \<and> is_finite_f32 cmax) NonFinite; assert (flt cmin cmax) InvalidConfig; layers_r \<leftarrow> foldl (\<lambda>acc_r i. acc_r >>= (\<lambda>acc. rsf_layer_init d cmin cmax gmean >>= (\<lambda>layer. return (layer # acc)))) (return []) [0..<num_layers]; let layers = rev layers_r in return \<lparr> rsf_num_layers = num_layers, rsf_layers = layers, rsf_dim = d, rsf_clip_min = cmin, rsf_clip_max = cmax, rsf_grad_mean = gmean, rsf_freed = False \<rparr> }"

definition split :: "nat \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> (tensor \<times> tensor) result" where
  "split d t = do { assert2DAndLen t; let [b, dim_total] = shape t in do { assert (dim_total = 2 * d) ShapeMismatch; let x1_data = concat (map (\<lambda>i. take d (drop (i * dim_total) (data t))) [0..<b]); let x2_data = concat (map (\<lambda>i. drop d (take ((i + 1) * dim_total) (drop (i * dim_total) (data t)))) [0..<b]); return (\<lparr> shape = [b, d], data = x1_data \<rparr>, \<lparr> shape = [b, d], data = x2_data \<rparr>) } }"

definition merge :: "tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor result" where
  "merge x1 x2 = do { assert2DAndLen x1; assert2DAndLen x2; let [b1, d1] = shape x1; let [b2, d2] = shape x2 in do { assert (b1 = b2 \<and> d1 = d2) ShapeMismatch; let merged_data = concat (map (\<lambda>i. (map (\<lambda>j. get_elem x1 i j) [0..<d1]) @ (map (\<lambda>j. get_elem x2 i j) [0..<d2])) [0..<b1]) in return \<lparr> shape = [b1, 2 * d1], data = merged_data \<rparr> } }"

definition rsf_forward :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor result" where
  "rsf_forward R x = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; assert2DAndLen x; let [b, dim_total] = shape x in do { assert (dim_total = 2 * rsf_dim R) ShapeMismatch; (x1, x2) \<leftarrow> split (rsf_dim R) x; (y1, y2) \<leftarrow> foldl (\<lambda>acc_r L. acc_r >>= (\<lambda>(a1, a2). rsf_layer_forward L a1 a2)) (return (x1, x2)) (rsf_layers R); merge y1 y2 } }"

definition rsf_inverse :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor result" where
  "rsf_inverse R y = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; assert2DAndLen y; let [b, dim_total] = shape y in do { assert (dim_total = 2 * rsf_dim R) ShapeMismatch; (y1, y2) \<leftarrow> split (rsf_dim R) y; (x1, x2) \<leftarrow> foldl (\<lambda>acc_r L. acc_r >>= (\<lambda>(a1, a2). rsf_layer_inverse L a1 a2)) (return (y1, y2)) (rev (rsf_layers R)); merge x1 x2 } }"

definition rsf_backward :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> tensor \<Rightarrow> (tensor \<times> rsf_layer_gradients list) result" where
  "rsf_backward R x grad_output = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; assert2DAndLen x; assert2DAndLen grad_output; let [b1, d1] = shape x; let [b2, d2] = shape grad_output in do { assert (b1 = b2 \<and> d1 = d2 \<and> d1 = 2 * rsf_dim R) ShapeMismatch; (x1_init, x2_init) \<leftarrow> split (rsf_dim R) x; (dy1_init, dy2_init) \<leftarrow> split (rsf_dim R) grad_output; (cur_x1, cur_x2, cur_dy1, cur_dy2, grads_list) \<leftarrow> foldl (\<lambda>acc_r L. acc_r >>= (\<lambda>(cx1, cx2, cdy1, cdy2, grads_acc). do { (y1, y2) \<leftarrow> rsf_layer_forward L cx1 cx2; (dx1, dx2, grad) \<leftarrow> rsf_layer_backward L cx1 cx2 y1 y2 cdy1 cdy2; return (y1, y2, dx1, dx2, grad # grads_acc) })) (return (x1_init, x2_init, dy1_init, dy2_init, [])) (rsf_layers R); grad_input \<leftarrow> merge cur_dy1 cur_dy2; return (grad_input, rev grads_list) } }"

definition rsf_deinit :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> rsf result" where
  "rsf_deinit R = return (R \<lparr> rsf_freed := True \<rparr>)"

definition rsf_zero_gradients :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> rsf_layer_gradients list result" where
  "rsf_zero_gradients R = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; return (map (\<lambda>L. rsf_gradients_init (dim L)) (rsf_layers R)) }"

type_synonym byte = "8 word"

definition to_le_u32 :: "32 word \<Rightarrow> byte list" where
  "to_le_u32 w = map (\<lambda>i. ucast ((w >> (8 * i)) AND 0xFF)) [0..<4]"

definition to_le_u64 :: "64 word \<Rightarrow> byte list" where
  "to_le_u64 w = map (\<lambda>i. ucast ((w >> (8 * i)) AND 0xFF)) [0..<8]"

definition from_le_u32 :: "byte list \<Rightarrow> 32 word option" where
  "from_le_u32 bs = (if length bs = 4 then Some (foldl (\<lambda>acc (i, b). acc OR ((ucast b) << (8 * i))) 0 (zip [0..<4] bs)) else None)"

definition from_le_u64 :: "byte list \<Rightarrow> 64 word option" where
  "from_le_u64 bs = (if length bs = 8 then Some (foldl (\<lambda>acc (i, b). acc OR ((ucast b) << (8 * i))) 0 (zip [0..<8] bs)) else None)"

definition float_to_bits :: "f32 \<Rightarrow> 32 word" where
  "float_to_bits f = word_of_int (sint (float_of f))"

definition bits_to_float :: "32 word \<Rightarrow> f32" where
  "bits_to_float w = IEEE.float_of (real_of_int (sint w))"

definition save_f32_list :: "f32 list \<Rightarrow> byte list" where
  "save_f32_list fs = concat (map (to_le_u32 \<circ> float_to_bits) fs)"

definition load_f32_list :: "byte list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> (f32 list \<times> byte list) option" where
  "load_f32_list bs n = (if length bs \<ge> n * 4 then let chunks = map (\<lambda>i. take 4 (drop (i * 4) bs)) [0..<n]; words = map (\<lambda>chunk. case from_le_u32 chunk of Some w \<Rightarrow> w | None \<Rightarrow> 0) chunks; floats = map bits_to_float words in Some (floats, drop (n * 4) bs) else None)"

definition rsf_save :: "rsf \<Rightarrow> byte list result" where
  "rsf_save R = do { assert (\<not> rsf_freed R) NotInitialized; assert (rsf_valid R) InvalidConfig; let magic = [82, 83, 70, 48] in let version = to_le_u32 1 in let num_layers_bytes = to_le_u64 (rsf_num_layers R) in let dim_bytes = to_le_u64 (rsf_dim R) in let clip_min_bytes = to_le_u32 (float_to_bits (rsf_clip_min R)) in let clip_max_bytes = to_le_u32 (float_to_bits (rsf_clip_max R)) in let grad_mean_byte = [if rsf_grad_mean R then 1 else 0] in let header = magic @ version @ num_layers_bytes @ dim_bytes @ clip_min_bytes @ clip_max_bytes @ grad_mean_byte in let layer_data = concat (map (\<lambda>L. let s_w = save_f32_list (data (s_weights L)); t_w = save_f32_list (data (t_weights L)); s_b = save_f32_list (s_bias L); t_b = save_f32_list (t_bias L) in s_w @ t_w @ s_b @ t_b) (rsf_layers R)) in return (header @ layer_data) }"

definition rsf_load :: "byte list \<Rightarrow> rsf result" where
  "rsf_load bytes = do { assert (length bytes \<ge> 37) BadFileFormat; let magic = take 4 bytes in assert (magic = [82, 83, 70, 48]) BadFileFormat; let version_bytes = take 4 (drop 4 bytes) in version \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u32 version_bytes of Some v \<Rightarrow> Ok v | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); assert (version = 1) UnsupportedVersion; let num_layers_bytes = take 8 (drop 8 bytes) in num_layers_word \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u64 num_layers_bytes of Some n \<Rightarrow> Ok n | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); let num_layers = unat num_layers_word in let dim_bytes = take 8 (drop 16 bytes) in dim_word \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u64 dim_bytes of Some d \<Rightarrow> Ok d | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); let d = unat dim_word in let clip_min_bytes = take 4 (drop 24 bytes) in clip_min_word \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u32 clip_min_bytes of Some w \<Rightarrow> Ok w | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); let cmin = bits_to_float clip_min_word in let clip_max_bytes = take 4 (drop 28 bytes) in clip_max_word \<leftarrow> (case from_le_u32 clip_max_bytes of Some w \<Rightarrow> Ok w | None \<Rightarrow> Err BadFileFormat); let cmax = bits_to_float clip_max_word in let grad_mean_byte = bytes ! 32 in let gmean = (grad_mean_byte = 1) in rsf_init num_layers d cmin cmax gmean }"
